_description: TY2025 New York State tax parameters. Used in the IT-203 (nonresident/part-year) pipeline. New York does NOT honor federal tax treaties — treaty-exempt income at the federal level is added back to NY taxable income (NY Publication 88). Source: NY Department of Taxation and Finance, NY Tax Law Article 22, IT-203 instructions for 2025.
_source: NY Tax Law §601; NYS DTF 2025 indexed amounts (subject to update upon NY release)
_status: PLACEHOLDER — verify and refresh values upon NYS DTF release of TY2025 indexed figures

standard_deduction._note: NY does not follow federal NRA restrictions — NY standard deduction is available to nonresident filers on IT-203 regardless of federal NRA status. NY uses domicile-based residency, not federal SPT.

residency_rules._note: NY statutory residency: domiciled in NY OR maintains a permanent place of abode in NY for more than 11 months AND spends more than 183 days in NY. Student dormitories generally do NOT count as a permanent place of abode (Matter of Petition of Knight). NY does NOT honor federal SPT.
residency_rules.student_dorm_exclusion_cite: Matter of Petition of Knight, NY DTA 2002

treaty_conformity._note: NY does NOT conform to federal tax treaties. Treaty-exempt federal wages/scholarships are added back to NY income on IT-203.
